verdict.rationale: Dover is a recruiting/ATS SaaS platform, so an official MCP server is a fair question for this kind of product and the axis applies. The pack never mentions an MCP server. The Dover API, the generic "connect AI tools" integrations line, and an llms.txt file are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not an official MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
